content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I'm working on a roof electroheating system. The controller will be used to operate self-regulating cable activation via contactors. I need to find a humidity sensor that works on a 12/24V DC supply. Any suggestions? Thanks

You can try using the [company_name] QFA 2.... series. These offer 0-10V/4-20mA output and DC supply versions. Check here: [url]. Go to products > sensors > humidity and select the sensor that suits your application.
